dataset: UAV-VisLoc, Zenodo record 19603534 (academic use only, no redistribution)
rule: whole regions per split; every flight in exactly one region; no flight in two splits
frames: positions in metres, east/north in each region's local ENU frame tangent to WGS84 at enu_origin (degrees, WGS84)

purpose.test: final test only; do not look at it while tuning or calibrating

hebei_huailai.place: Huailai-Yanqing area north-west of Beijing, China

jiangsu_wuxi.status: excluded from tune/calibrate/test, reserved as a cross-modal stress test
jiangsu_wuxi.note: modality found from the overlays (2026-11-18); the dataset metadata does not say it

note: public copy: coordinates removed (enu_origin, chip_centre_bbox). Regenerate the full file with `python3 eval/make_splits.py` after downloading UAV-VisLoc; the loader needs enu_origin.
